mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (member_id, category_id, content, image_url, subscriber_only) VALUES (#{memberId},#{categoryId},#{content},#{imageUrl},#{subscriberOnly})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.member_id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.content, p.image_url, p.like_count, p.view_count, p.subscriber_only, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM post p JOIN common_code c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
